name: approximates_deriv_on_nhds
statement: E → F} {f' : E →L[𝕜] F} {a : E} (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a) {c : ℝ≥0} (hc : Subsingleton E ∨ 0 < c) : ∃ s ∈ 𝓝 a, ApproximatesLinearOn f f' s c

name: map_nhds_eq_of_surj
statement: E → F} {f' : E →L[𝕜] F} {a : E} (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f (f' : E →L[𝕜] F) a) (h : f'.range = ⊤) : map f (𝓝 a) = 𝓝 (f a)
